name: Coarse-to-fine Centroidal Voronoi Tesselation (CVT)
definition: A method to densify continuous Signed Distance Function (SDF) discretization near a surface by simultaneously optimizing SDF values and their discretization sites, avoiding explicit Voronoi cell computation.
summary: Coarse-to-fine CVT densifies SDF discretization near surfaces by optimizing sites and values, avoiding explicit Voronoi computation to ensure uniform vertex distribution.
